tenancy_and_users.description: Multi-tenant boundary enforcement, organization hierarchies, user accounts, invitations, and identity mappings.

contacts_and_crm.description: Audience management, contact attributes, dynamic/static segmentation, subscription status, topics, Google Sheets sync, and suppression lists.

campaigns_and_templates.description: Marketing email campaigns, run orchestration, snapshot audience bindings, sending holds, and template draft versioning.

email_delivery_and_ses.description: Outbound email queuing, AWS SES event ingestion, delivery confirmations, send attempts, recipient outcomes, SMTP credentials, and sending domain DKIM/SPF identities.

mailboxes_and_inbound.description: Inbound email handling, mailbox alias routing, received emails storage, and Stalwart mail server integration.

automation_and_events.description: Trigger-based automation state machines, execution step tracking, event receipts, delayed waiting events, and queue worker coordination.

billing_and_subscriptions.description: Tiered plans, add-ons, credit transactions, payment ledgers, Dodo Payments webhook reconciliation, quota period tracking, and sending limits.

developer_api_and_oauth.description: External API key provisioning, request auditing, egress webhook dispatch, OAuth2 application authentication, and Supabase integration bridges.

growth_referrals_and_blog.description: Affiliate partner referrals, commission earnings, withdrawal requests, and public marketing blog CMS.

lifecycle_and_notifications.description: Inactivity tracking, account deletion workflows, automated reminder notices, and multi-channel system notifications.

admin_support_and_logging.description: Internal staff RBAC, customer support ticketing, AI assistant queries, unified audit logs, workspace asset uploads, and system settings.

external_infrastructure.description: External auth, storage, pg_cron, pg_net, and vault schemas managed by Supabase platform.
